answer: To resist Sybil attacks, the economy enforces quadratic stake burning per identity registration. An attacker creating n replicas burns tokens scaling as O(n^2), rendering mass spoofing mathematically ruinous. Each agent embeds cryptographic proof of work, like signing a sonnet hash or anchoring a unique pigment watermark onto the ledger. Staking yields pool into a common reserve lagoon, ensuring economic friction scales superlinearly.
